title: Lemon Chicken Scaloppine
author: Lorenzo
description: Thin chicken cutlets in a quick butter and lemon pan sauce.
steps: Season the chicken and dust it in flour, shaking off the excess.
Brown it in the oil and half the butter, 2 minutes a side, and set aside.
Pour in the wine and lemon juice, scrape the pan, then add the rest of the butter.
Return the chicken and turn it in the sauce for a minute until it thickens. Finish with parsley.
